travel.description: Travel, local exploration, leisure, recreation, and outings.
travel.coverage_note: Directions, nearby places, weather, time, destination background, attractions, live bookable experiences, and search-only Duffel flight offers are available. OneBusAway adds real-time public transit for its Puget Sound deployment. Duffel test tokens return sandbox rather than realistic schedules and prices; rail and hotel coverage may still be incomplete.

health.description: Health, well-being, symptoms, healthcare, pharmacy situations, and everyday health management.
health.coverage_note: Can locate care, retrieve biomedical background and official drug information, inspect packaged-food nutrition, search FDA recalls and device clearances, run specialized medical calculations, and inspect fruit nutrition. It cannot verify local drug inventory, make appointments, or replace professional diagnosis.

shopping.description: Products, services, purchasing, comparison, replacement, and everyday spending decisions.
shopping.coverage_note: Can locate stores and retrieve general, community, and live web information for product discovery and price research. It still has no stable retailer inventory or order-management integration.

career_learning.description: Work, education, skills, employment, professional development, and career changes.
career_learning.coverage_note: Can provide general background, software documentation, AI resources, papers, academic events, and read-only remote-job search. It still lacks community discussion search and a general course, school, or certification catalog.
